modification_notice: The distributed model.onnx is a deterministic export from the pinned original safetensors, using FP16 weights, an eager encoder and FP32 Sigmoid output. All 393 original tensors are bound in one graph file; no external runtime tensors are required. It is not a vendor-provided ONNX graph. This companion builder only verifies and packages the approved prepared files.
quality_notice: Hash verification establishes artifact identity, not retrieval quality. Same-precision and original-FP32 numerical comparisons are reported separately without changing tolerances. Consumed v22, v27 and v43 failures are preserved. The latest complete 196-case/40-query v43 evaluation passed automatic-admission precision/recall and returned-source noise, but failed legitimate explicit storage and continuation Hit@5; joint required evidence was sufficient for only 2/40 queries. No production-quality certification or universal relevance probability is asserted.
